notes: Screen changes take twice as long, which is to say you can now see them. Switching tabs, opening Settings or the paywall, and stepping into Language or Course & tutor from Profile all fade through at the same doubled length, so moving around the app reads as movement rather than as a blink between two states. The Profile sub-pages were a simultaneous crossfade, the one shape the rest of the app avoids: both screens painted at once means the old one lingers over the new. They now leave before the next one arrives, like everything else.
